effects.name: Edge Glow
effects.description: Ambilight-style glow that mirrors the source monitor's edge colors onto adjacent displays.

effects.name: Plasma Flow
effects.description: Slow-breathing plasma clouds tinted by the screen palette and stirred by the music.

effects.name: Spectrum Bars
effects.description: A glowing frequency spectrum with reflections, colored by what's on screen.

effects.name: Particle Field
effects.description: Thousands of GPU particles drifting through screen colors and pulsing with the beat.

effects.name: Aurora
effects.description: Northern-lights ribbons that ripple with bass and take their colors from the screen edges.

effects.name: Nebula
effects.description: Deep-space color clouds torn into glowing filaments, with stars that flare to the music.

effects.name: Fire
effects.description: Rising flames and embers that flare with the bass — ember-ramp or screen-colored.

effects.name: Rain
effects.description: Falling light streaks tinted by your screen, gusting harder with the bass.

effects.name: Waveform
effects.description: A glowing oscilloscope line tracing the music, tinted by your screen or a fixed color.

effects.name: Kaleidoscope
effects.description: A spinning mandala of mirrored color that pumps and blooms with the bass.

effects.name: Ripple
effects.description: Dark water where every beat drops an expanding ring of screen-colored light.
